pieces.Text: A scaleheart skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a scaleheart skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Strength. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a scaleheart skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, darkvision to a range of 60 feet, swim speed of 30 feet, or ferocity (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary). These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
